Commentary.Commentary: We are back for the chase! South Africa Under-19 players spread out on the field as the English openers, George Thomas and Jacob Bethell take guard. Matthew Boast has the new ball in hand.
... The Run Chase ...
England are a side which have been doing really well with the bat. They will back themselves to gun it down. South Africa need to bowl really well. Can they defend this? We will find out.

South Africa on the other hand, just have one man to thank for the position they are in. Yes, the last wicket contributed nicely but Brevis' innings was the stand-out. Had it not been for him, his side would have fallen well short of 200. He played a blinder and was very unfortunate to not get to the three-figure mark. Also, had he received support from the rest, South Africa could have well posted close to the 250-run mark. That is not the case though and they now have a under par score to defend.

It was the new ball bowlers who set the tone! Especially Boyden who got two early on. Then there was a period where runs started to flow for South Africa but Rehan was brilliant after being introduced. He got crucial wickets and pegged them back. Sales then played an important role by taking a couple of wickets in one over which put England in firm control. They did let it slip away a little, just a little by letting them cross the 200-run mark but overall, England will be pleased with how they performed in the field.
So, South Africa's last pair has helped them crawl over the 200-run mark but have to say, England will be very pleased with their work and are firm favorites to move into the semi finals.

OUT! RUN OUT! That's it, the South African innings comes to an end. In the end, it does take a run out to get the final wicket but this last wicket partnership has been thoroughly entertaining. Short, on off and cut away towards point for a quick single. Joshua Boyden over there is onto it in a flash and fires in a good throw towards the keeper. Alex Horton whips off the bails in a flash. The replay shows that this time the dive doesn't save Tshaka. South Africa Under-19 end with 209/10!
A run out appeal! This looks out and it is referred. England are celebrating.
Flatter one, on middle. Kept out on the off side.

Another mix-up but the batters survive yet again. Quicker one, on off. Tshaka plays it late towards backward point. His partner wants the single but there's a bit of hesistation. Tshaka puts in the dive and makes it home safely.
Drifted into middle and leg. Blocked out.
Back of a length, around off. Tshaka hops and steers it through point for one more.
Full and straight, driven down to long on for one.
Slower one, sliding down leg. Tshaka waits for it and works it 'round the corner for one.
Leg bye! On the pads, Boast misses the flick. The ball goes off the pads towards square leg and they get a leg bye.
Length again, angled into the pads. Boast makes room and looks to slog it away but misses.
A length ball, close to off. Tshaka plays it late and guides it towards third man for a single.
Looking for two but won't get it. On middle, this is worked off the back foot towards mid-wicket for one.
Was that a dropped catch? Short and wide, this is hammered off the back foot to the left of extra cover. Rew does well to get a hand on it and the batters get a run.
Flatter one, around off. Boast rocks back and cuts it to the right of point but the fielder makes a great stop.
Around middle and leg, Tshaka works it past the bowler towards mid on for a single.
Angled into off. Tshaka prods to block it out.
On a length, on off. Tshaka defends it off the back foot.
They've got to 200 now. On leg, tucked away towards mid-wicket for a quick single. The last wicket partnership is now worth 31 runs.
FOUR! That's really well played too! Shorter in length, around off. Tshaka hops and cuts it past the point fielder for back-to-back boundaries. The score moves on to 199.
FOUR! What a shot! Asakhe Tshaka, the number 11 batter just takes a couple of steps down the track and pumps the ball over the bowler's head for a boundary.
Length again, around off. This is pushed onto the off side for a single.
A length ball, angling in from around off. Kept out.
Run out appeal and it is taken upstairs!

NOT OUT! Full and angling into middle and leg. Tshaka flicks it straight to mid-wicket and Matthew Boast calls him for a quick run. James Rew is quick to latch on to the ball and scores a direct hit at the keeper's end. The decision is taken upstairs. The replay shows that Boast's bat was just in when the bails popped. He lives to fight on.
Powerplay 3 signaled! Now 5 fielders can be placed outside the ring till the 50th over.
Very full, close to the off pole. Boast looks to cover drive but misses.
SIX! Matthew Boast is boosting his side's score here. This is banged in halfway down the track, Boast just hangs deep and muscles it high and long over the wide long on fence for another maximum.
Boast makes room on the leg side and Sales follows him. Boast can't get it through on the off side.
Full, on off and driven through cover for a single.
Change of length and change of pace from Sales. Short, on off and slower in pace. Tshaka misses the cut off the back foot.
A length ball, on off and sliding across. Tshaka has a poke at it but misses.
A touch short and wide, cut away straight to point. End of a brilliant spell from Rehan Ahmed. He ends with figures of 10-1-48-4!
On a length, on middle. This one turns in sharply and Boast gets hit on the pads.
This is sliding across the off stump. Boast edges it down with soft hands towards slip.
Quicker one, on off. Boast blocks it out.
SIX! WOW! Tossed up, on middle. Matthew Boast just hangs back and lifts it well over the long on fence for a biggie. Can he power his side to that 200-run mark?
On leg, Boast makes a watchful block.
Full, around off. Boast jams it out on the off side for a quick single. Boast is adding valuable runs to this total now.

Huge opportunity to wrap up the innings! Back of a length, around off and guided towards point. Tshaka is backing up way too much and the fielder has a firm throw towards the bowler. James Sales fails to collect and Tshaka survives.
FOUR! Edged away! Full and wide, Matthew Boast throws the kitchen sink at it and gets a thick outside edge which flies over short third man for a welcome boundary.
On a good length, around off. Tshaka taps it towards point for a single.
Nicely bowled! In that channel around off, and angling across. Tshaka goes front and back to block but the ball zips past the outside edge.
Full and wide, slashed away to deep point for a single by Boast.
Quicker, shorter and turning in a mile from outside off. Tshaka is pushed on the back foot and gets hit on the pads yet again. A wicket-maiden for Rehan Ahmed.
On off, pushed away onto the off side.
Big, big turn but probably doing too much. Ahmed goes 'round the wicket and turns it in from around off. Tshaka hops back to block but can't keep up with the turn and is rapped on the pads.
Beaten! Quicker one, on a length and going across the left-hander. Tshaka looks to block but is well beaten.
Asakhe Tshaka is the last man in for South Africa Under-19.

OUT! TAKEN! Number 9 down! Rehan has 4. He tosses it up outside off, it is the googly. Aphiwe Mnyanda looks to sweep, this goes off the top edge and straight into the hands of the mid-wicket fielder. Prest takes it another dolly.
Commentary.Howout: c Tom Prest b Rehan Ahmed

Commentary.Commentary: Half an appeal but turned down! This lands outside off, Mnyanda walks across and looks to sweep but misses. Hit outside off.
Another short one to end an over with two wickets in it. Boast ducks under it.
A good short one, Boast ducks under it.
On middle, defended.
Aphiwe Mnyanda is in at number 10.

OUT! TAKEN! Another one bites the dust and England well and truly on top now! What a move to get on Sales. He has two in the over. On the body, Alder looks to flick but it goes off the top edge high up in the air towards square leg. The man in the deep runs in, dives forward and takes it brilliantly. Luxton it was.
Commentary.Howout: c William Luxton b James Sales

Commentary.Commentary: On middle, this is worked through square leg for one.
Matthew Boast walks in to bat at number 9.

OUT! TAKEN! Heartbreak for Brevis! He deserved a ton! 96 in the previous game and 97 in this one! Very unfortunate on missing out a ton but this has been a beautiful innings. He is the sole reason for the position his side are in. They aren't in a great one but would have been in a terrible position had it not been for him. He takes a few steps down the track. Sales bangs it short and into the body. Brevis looks to flick but closes the face of the bat early. It goes off the leading edge and the man at covers, Rew takes a good diving catch to his left. A standing ovation for Brevis as he walks back and deserves every bit of it. England can now keep South Africa Under-19 below 200 now.
Commentary.Howout: c James Rew b James Sales

Commentary.Commentary: James Sales (5-1-18-0) is brought back into the attack.
Brevis keeps strike now as he plays it towards cover for one. He moves onto 97.
Shorter and on middle, this is pulled through mid-wicket for one.
On the stumps yet again, it is pushed to covers.
On off, blocked.
On middle, Alder works it back to the bowler.
That is very nicely played! Fuller and outside off, this is driven through covers for two.

DRINKS! The middle phase of the first innings is moving along at a rapid pace. Runs have been scored, wickets have fallen and Dewald Brevis has just about kept South Africa Under-19 in it. Rehan Ahmed has done the damage for England Under-19 in the middle overs and has picked up three wickets. Brevis is inching closer to that hundred and the longer he stays out there, the more damage he can do. England though will be looking to knock over the South African lower order at the earliest and keep them to a score of about 200.
FOUR! He really hits the ball so very hard and now is only another boundary away from a ton! On middle, fuller, this is powered down to the long on fence.
Shorter and outside off, Brevis cuts it to point.
FOUR! Into the 90s with a beautiful shot! He makes room, this is full and on middle, he lifts it over covers for a boundary.
Fuller and on the pads, this is worked through square leg for one.
Shorter and on middle, Brevis pushes it down to long on for one.

DROPPED! It would have been a special catch! James Rew! This is tossed up on off, Alder drives it uppishly to the left of the fielder at cover. Rew dives, stretches a hand out but the ball does not stay in. A single taken. Would have been a catch to remember.
Outside off, this is driven through covers for one.
ON middle, blocked.
On off, kept out.
Flatter and on off, this is hit down hard to long on for one.
SIX! SHOT! That shot had so much of ABD in it! He is dealing in boundaries now! The slog sweep is out, he nails it and it goes over mid-wicket. He is class apart this lad.
Gets Brevis on strike! On the pads, this is worked through square leg for one.
Alder now keeps strike as he nudges it towards mid-wicket and gets to the other end.
Another one on the stumps, Alder stays back and blocks.
Shorter and on middle, Alder keeps it out.
On middle, it is kept out.
Now follows the biggie with a single as he works it through square leg. Moves into the 80s now.
SIX! That is huge! This is what he cna do, he just needs someone to hang in there with him! On middle, fuller, this is smashed over the long on fence for a biggie.
On the stumps, Alder keeps it out. End of another good over from Rehan.
On off, blocked.
On middle, defended.
Shorter and outside off, this is slapped through covers for one.

OUT! TAKEN! Another one bites the dust and it is all falling apart for South Africa! Dewald Brevis can't believe what he is seeing at the other end, he just needs someone to hang around with him but no one is doing so. Rehan gets his third. This is tossed up on middle, Michael Copeland looks to go big, he tries to clear the long on fence but hits it straight up in the air towards the fielder there. It is taken by George. South Africa Under-19 slip further.
Commentary.Howout: c George Thomas b Rehan Ahmed

Commentary.Commentary: Shorter and on off, this is slapped through covers for one.
Shorter, on middle. Brevis punches it off the back foot towards long on for a single.
Leg bye! Down the leg side, Copeland looks to sweep. The ball goes off his pads towards short fine leg. They get a leg bye.
Full, on middle. Brevis steps out and drills it towards long off for one more.
On middle, this is chipped right back over the bowler's head for a single.
On a length, angled across off. Copeland defends it off the front foot.
Tossed up, on middle. Brevis uses his feet and drills it straight back towards the bowler. Tom Prest does well to get a hand on it but they do scamper through for a run.
Quicker, on off. Copeland just about manages to keep it out.
Michael Copeland is in at number 7.

OUT! Cleaned up! Rehan Ahmed with yet another wrong 'un and Andile Simelane is sent packing! This is bowled a bit quicker, on a length and around off. Simelane hops back and looks to cut but he hasn't read the googly at all. The ball turns in sharply and knocks over the stumps. Andile Simelane is out for a duck and Rehan Ahmed is making the ball talke here. South Africa Under-19 on a slump here.
On off. Defended out.

FOUR BYES! What happened here? There was a sound and it seemed like it was off the wicket. Nicely flighted, on off and it is the googly. The batter is completely beaten and so is the keeper. The ball goes just past the leg stump and into the fine leg fence.
Pushed through on off. Simelane blocks it off the back foot.
Short and wide, this is slapped through extra cover for a single.
Around middle and leg, this is nudged onto the leg side.
Prest gives this one a lot more air and bowls it around off. Simelane blocks it out.
On off, this is worked towards extra cover for a single.
Flatter one, angled across off. Brevis can't get it past the bowler.
On off, this is broomed away towards deep square leg. The fielder from deep backward square leg runs around quickly and keeps it down to two.
FOUR! Top shot! Tossed up, around off. Dewald Brevis maneuvers it brilliantly through the extra cover region and picks up another boundary.
On off. Blocked out.
Andile Simelane is the new man in.

OUT! CAUGHT! The skipper was being bogged down for a long time and finally crumbles under pressure. Nicely tossed up, on a length and around middle. George Van Heerden looks to join in on the party and goes for the big slog sweep. He only manges to get a top edge and the ball pops up around the short leg region. The keeper, Alex Horton simply walks towards it and takes an easy catch. Huge wicket this in the context of the game and Rehan Ahmed has some redemption.
Commentary.Howout: c Alex Horton b Rehan Ahmed

Commentary.Commentary: This is pushed through quicker, around off. Van Heerden just about keeps it out.
On middle, this is pushed down to long on for one.
Here comes the googly. The ball pitches on off and turns in sharply. Brevis stays deep and watchfully works it through mid-wicket for a couple.

SIX! Huge hit! Dewald Brevis has hit that pure. Tossed up, on middle. Brevis shuffles a bit and slogs it well over the mid-wicket fence for a biggie. Geez, that pose was so similar to AB, the resemblance is uncanny.
Shorter in length, around off. Van Heerden defends it out.
A touch shorter, around leg. Brevis turns it on the leg side for a single.
Nicely tossed up. Dewald Brevis looks to flick it towards mid-wicket but can't get it past the bowler yet again.
On middle. This is pushed back towards the bowler.
Tossed up, on middle. Brevis can't get it past the bowler.
On a length, around leg. Van Heerden hangs back and works it towards backward square leg for a single.
This is dragged down and Ahmed's got away with that one. George Van Heerden rocks back and pulls it towards wide long on for a single. At the halfway stage, South Africa Under-19 are 106/3!
Flatter one, on off. Van Heerden keeps it out on the off side.
Sliding onto middle and leg. Blocked out.
There's the fifty, another brilliant knock from Dewald Brevis. Tossed up, on middle. Brevis pushes it down to long on for one.

Extra run! On middle, Brevis goes deep in his crease to tuck it away leg side. The fielder at square leg has a shy at the bowler's end but misses and they get an extra run. Moves to 49 now does Brevis.
On a length, sliding onto leg. Van Heerden just knocks it 'round the corner for one.
Good running yet again! Full, angled onto the pads. Van Heerden pushes it towards mid on and sets off for a quick single.
A touch shorter, outside off. Brevis slaps it towards extra cover for a single. The 100 is up for South Africa Under-19.

FOUR! Brevis on the other hand is looking in full flow now. Short, on off and this one just sits up nicely. Dewald Brevis hangs back and muscles the pull shot into the cow corner fence. Geez, that made a good sound off the bat.
Drop and run! Back of a length, at the body. Van Heerden dabs it down towards short mid-wicket and scampers through for a quick run. Good running.
On a good length, slower in pace and angling in from around off. Van Heerden tucks it onto the leg side.
George Van Heerden is really being bogged down here. Short of a length, outside off. Van Heerden stays leg side and taps it towards point.
Short and wide, this is firmly cut away to deep point for one.
Flatter again, a touch shorter and close to the off stump. Van Heerden guides it off the back foot towards backward point.
Quicker and flatter, around off. Van Heerden hops back and dabs it down towards backward point.
On off, driven on the up towards extra cover.
Nicely flighted, on off. Brevis drives it down to long on for a run.
FOUR! Lucky! Tossed up, full and on off. Dewald Brevis looks to drive away from the body but the ball goes off the inside and past the leg stump. The ball races away into the fine leg fence.
Right around the top of off. Van Heerden stays solid in defense.

There is a halt in play! The ball just bounces in front of the keeper, Alex Horton and bounces up to hit him on the head. The keeper says he's fine but there will be a mandatory concussion check done. Everything seems fine and play will now continue.
That one stayed down a touch. On a shorter length, outside off. George Van Heerden hops and looks to cut but the ball but it goes below his willow.
Nicely bowled, into that channel outside off. Van Heerden leaves it alone.
Pitched up, close to the off pole. Van Heerden pushes it out on the off side.
On middle, Brevis shuffles and tucks it away behind square for a single.
WIDE! A good short ball, outside off but it's a bit too short for the umpire's liking. The replay shows that it was well over Brevis' head.
A low full toss, tailing into leg. Brevis clears the front leg and drills it straight towards mid on.
Another dot to end a maiden over! Flatter, on off. Van Heerden gets behind the line of the ball to block.
Flighted, around off. Van Heerden presses forward and pushes it towards cover.
Short again, outside off. Van Heerden hangs back and drops it towards backward point. He looks for the quick single but it isn't there.
Shorter, on off. This is tapped towards cover-point.
Tossed up, on off. Van Heerden can't get it through extra cover.
Flatter, pushed through on middle and leg. Van Heerden keeps it out.
George Van Heerden is off the mark! Fuller and on off, this is pushed through covers for one.
Fuller and on off, it is played back to the bowler.
Shorter and outside off, Brevis looks to cut it hard but gets an underededge on the off side for one.
He has hit that hard too! Brevis is in the mood! Walks at the bowler again and makes it into a half volley, he smacks it again but to mid off.
FOUR! Two in two! Shorter and on middle, this time Brevis was ready for it, he stands tall and pulls it over mid-wicket for a boundary.
FOUR! That is hammered! What a hit! A wicket has just fallen in the last over but Brevis does not care. He walks down, makes it into a half volley and slams it back past the bowler.
The skipper, George Van Heerden is in at number 5. Also, Tom Aspinwall is brought into the attack.

OUT! TIMBER! The stand which was worrying England a touch has been broken! Bethell is the one to break the stand! Maree, time and again, has been walking across, looking to target the leg side. This time, Bethell goes full and quicker and bowls it on the stumps. Maree sweeps but misses and the stumps are hit. Important wicket.

FOUR LEG BYES! That has spun sharply! This lands outside off, Maree goes back and looks to push it but this one turns in quickly, it hits the pad, beats the keeper and goes down to the fine leg fence.
The sweep is out, it is played through square leg for one.
Outside off, fuller, this is hit down to long off for one.
On middle, this is worked to mid-wicket.
Very nicely played! On middle, Brevis goes down on one knee and paddle sweeps it fine. The fielder in the deep, runs to his right, dives and saves a run for his side.

DRINKS! Joshua Boyden and James Sales started off brightly with the ball for England Under-19 and Boyden picked up two early wickets as well. South Africa Under-19 were under the pump in the first 10 overs but since then, Gerhardus Maree and Dewald Brevis have done extremely well to stay at the crease and keep the scoreboard moving. They still need to pick up the run rate but the match is set up nicely here.
A dot to end but a welcome big over for South Africa! The googly to end outside off, this turns away. Maree looks to guide it down to third man but misses.
Maree shuffles across again, Ahmed gives it flight and gets it to to dip on middle, Maree somehow manages to keep it out.
FOUR! Outstanding batting! A biggie over mid-wicket and now the reverse sweep. He takes it on the full and plays it behind square on the off side.
Well fielded! On middle, Maree works it but the man at mid-wicket dives to his left and saves a run.
SIX! Over the fielder! That is right off the middle. He really got hold of it. On middle, turning back in. Maree plays the slog sweep, it flies over the deep mid-wicket fielder.
Fuller and on off, this is hit hard down to long off for one.
Maree moves well across outside off, this is bowled even wider outside off. He tries to sweep but misses.
Full and on the pads, this is worked down towards fine leg for one more.
On off, this is played back to the bowler.
Fuller and on off, Brevis drives but to covers.
Shorter and outside off, this is cut but to point.
Well fielded! Fuller and on off, Brevis drives, the fielder at covers, dives to his left and stops it.
Slightly shorter and on off, turning back in. Maree looks to pull but gets an inside edge onto the pads.
An appeal but probably turning a lot! This lands outside off and then spins back in. Maree looks to defend but misses. It hits him high on the pads too.
The googly, it lands outside off and spins away. Maree looks to guide it down to third man but misses.
On middle, defended.
Misfield and a run! Good turn for the bowler there! Shorter and outside off, Brevis cuts it towards point. The fielder makes a half stop and a run is taken.
Flatter and on off, this is played back to the bowler.
Rehan Ahmed to bowl now.
Flatter and on off, this is pushed through covers for one.
On middle, Maree flicks it through mid-wicket and gets to the other end.
Well played in the end! Brevis comes down the track and the bowler shortens his length. Brevis slaps it through covers for one.
On middle, this is worked through mid-wicket for one.
A single as this is pushed to long off. 50 for South Africa.
On off, Brevis guides it to point.
Quicker and on off, Maree guides it to point. So another good over for South Africa, 8 from it.
Angled into middle this time, it is worked to mid-wicket.
Shorter and outside off, Maree looks to cut but misses.
FOUR! AND AGAIN! This time off the front foot! Consecutive boundaries! Maree again walks right across, this is bowled full and on off, he sweeps it through square leg and it races away to the fence.
FOUR! Really good batting! Maree just moves across his stumps, this is bowled short and he pulls it behind square on the leg side for a boundary.
On middle, defended.
On middle, this is worked through mid-wicket for one.
Goes on with the arm! Outside off, Maree plays for the turn into him but this goes on with the arm and beats the outside edge.
Hit hard but only for one! Outside off, this is slammed through covers but straight to the sweeper for a single.
Fuller and on off, this is driven to covers.
Outside off, left alone.
Flatter and on middle, Brevis hangs back and blocks.
Spin from both ends now as Jacob Bethell comes on to bowl.
Another run as this is eased down to long on. 4 from Prest's first.
On middle, Brevis defends it.
Tosses it up on middle, this is pushed down to mid on for one.
On middle, defended.
On the shorter side and outside off, extra bounce on this one. Maree looks to cut but gets an underedge which hits the boot of the keeper.
Hesitation but no harm done in the end! On off, this is pushed through covers. They take one, think of a second, they take off late but complete it in the end.
The skipper, Tom Prest brings himself into the attack now.
So five dots after the biggie, a good comeback by the bowler! On middle, defended.
Continues to bowl it wide outside off, this time it is left alone.
Slightly fuller again, Brevis guides it to point.
On off, Brevis pushes it to covers this time.
Hit hard but does not find the gap! Shorter and outside off, Brevis cuts it hard but to point.
SIX! Bang! What a shot that is! Wonderful! Slightly fuller, right in the slot for Brevis, he lofts it over the bowler's head and it goes all the way.
Powerplay 2 has been signaled! Now a total of 4 fielders can be placed outside the ring till the 40th over.

Nicely bowled! On a length, around middle and just angles across the off stump. Maree plays down the wrong line and gets beaten past the outside edge. South Africa Under-19 are 29/2 at the end of the first Powerplay!
This is angled into middle and leg. Brevis pushes it towards mid on and sets off for a quick single. Good running.
Full, on off. This is driven firmly towards mid off.
Uppish but through! A touch fuller this time and wider, Maree drives on the up and just gets it past the point fielder for a single.
Length again, this time it's wider of the off stump. Maree shoulders arms.
A length ball, angled across off. Maree makes a watchful leave.
On off, kept out on the off side.
Well left! Fullish ball, around the off pole and left alone. The keeper is up to the stumps and is looking sharp.
A touch fuller, angled well across off. Brevis hangs deep and leaves it alone.
On a good length, on off and shaping in. Brevis taps it onto the off side.
FOUR! Width on offer and punished! A bit too full, too wide. Dewald Brevis leans into it and creams it through cover for a boundary.
Nicely bowled! Full, on off and shaping away. Maree looks to drive but edges it down to third man for a single.
Just the leg bye off it! On a good length, nipping back in sharply from around off. Brevis looks to work it away on the leg side but gets hit high on the pads.
Back of a length, angled at the body. Brevis taps it back onto the deck.
Outside off, this is punched towards cover.
Almost chopped on! Short and wide, Brevis looks to cut off the back foot but gets an inside edge onto the deck.

Leg bye! Fullish ball, around leg. Maree looks to flick but the ball goes off the pads and towards square leg. They scamper through for a leg bye. An appeal from the bowler but seems to be pitching outside leg.
Very full, on off. Maree drives it gently towards mid on.
Beauty! Boyden pitches it up, around the off pole. The ball just straightens after pitching and beats the outside edge of Brevis' bat by a whisker.
Slower in pace, well outside off. No shot offered by Brevis.
A good-length ball, outside off. Brevis lets it through to the keeper.
Who will walk out to bat next? Gerhardus Maree it is.

OUT! TAKEN! Ethan-John Cunningham tries to up the ante but perishes! Cunningham was looking a bit edgy out there and went for too much too early here. Joshua Boyden hits the length hard, around off. Cunningham makes room leg side and looks to lift it over the long off fence. He manages only to slice it high in the area, around the cover region. Jacob Bethell takes a couple of steps backwards and holds on to a fine catch. England Under-19 right on top of proceedings here and Joshua Boyden has his second.
Commentary.Howout: c Jacob Bethell b Joshua Boyden

Commentary.Commentary: Full and straight, drilled back towards the bowler.
FOUR! Just over! Fuller in length, around off. Ethan-John Cunningham clears the front leg out of the way and thumps it over the head of the mid off fielder and collects a boundary.
A good bumper this time, over off. Brevis ducks under it.

FOUR! Dewald Brevis is off the mark! Full, sliding onto leg. Brevis shuffles a bit and tucks it away towards the mid-wicket fence. The fielder from inside the ring gives chase and manages to cut it off but unfortunately for him, his hands touched the rope whilst the ball still in hand.
WIDE! Dewald Brevis is moving a lot in the crease, trying to throw off the bowler. Sales spills this one well outside off and a wide is called.
Well fielded! On off, Dewald Brevis shuffles across the stumps and flicks it straight towards mid-wicket. Rew over there makes a sharp stop to his right.
Around the top of off. Brevis stays solid in defense.
Brevis is standing outside off and Sales bowls it even wider. The ball is shaping away and Brevis makes a watchful leave.
Very full, outside off. Cunningham squeezes it down to third man for a single.
Fuller and wider, Brevis with an easy leave. End of a wicket-maiden from Joshua Boyden.
On a good length, around leg and angling away. The ball just holds in the pitch a bit and Brevis dabs it down towards backward point.
A length, on off. Brevis presses forward and pushes it out on the off side.
Fuller and around off. Brevis makes a watchful leave.
Dewald Brevis walks out to bat now. He has been excellent in the tournament so far. Needs to play well here.

OUT! TAKEN! The skipper takes a good catch and England Under-19 have the first breakthrough! This has been a brilliant start with the ball from the two young pacers. Joshua Boyden pitches it up, around the off pole and angles it away nicely. Valentine Kitime is caught on the crease as he neither goes forward nor backwards and pushes at it with hard hands. The ball goes off the outside edge to the right of Tom Prest at first slip and he takes a fine low catch.
Commentary.Howout: c Tom Prest b Joshua Boyden

Commentary.Commentary: Short of a length, angled across off. Kitime slaps it hard but can't get it through cover.

FOUR! Streaky boundary but it is in fact the first one of the day.  Ethan-John Cunningham makes room leg side and Sales follows him with a length ball. Cunningham gets an inside edge past the leg stump and into the fine leg fence.
WIDE! Full and wide again, a bit too wide this time from Sales. Wided.
Just sliding down leg. On a length, around middle and angling in. Cunningham looks to flick it away leg side but misses and gets hit on the pads. A hopeful appeal from the keeper and nothing more.
Length again, around off. This is kept out on the off side.
Full and wide, Ethan-John Cunningham slices it behind point and picks up a couple of runs.
On a good length, angled into middle. Cunningham keeps it out off the back foot.
Right around the top of off. Cunningham taps it towards cover.
Full and straight, Kitime defends it back to the bowler. Just the single off it.
And he's away! A touch shorter, angled across off. Cunningham hangs back and cuts it uppishly through backward point for one.
Cunningham still can't get off the mark. Full and straight, driven firmly but straight towards mid on.
A length ball, close to the off pole and shaping back in. Cunningham cuts it late towards point.
Uppish again! Fullish ball, outside off. Cunningham stands tall and drives it on the up towards cover-point.
Pitched up, around off. Cunningham presses forward and pushes it towards cover.
Short and wide, it is there to hit but Kitime leaves it alone.
WIDE! Trying to attack the pads but this is spilled down the leg side. Wided.
Peach! Sales goes a bit wider of the crease yet again and angles it in. The ball just straightens after pitching and goes agonizingly past the outside edge of Kitime's bat.
Good-length ball, outside off. Kitime makes a watchful leave.
South Africa Under-19 are away! Back of a length, at the body. Valentine Kitime tucks it through mid-wicket and gets off the mark with a couple.
This is angled in from wide of the crease and just shapes away a bit. Kitime pushes it towards cover.
Very full and wide, left alone.
Who will bowl from the other end? It's going to be James Sales.
On a good length this time, over off. Cunningham pats it back to the bowler. Boyden starts off with a maiden.
On off, wonderfully driven back past the bowler but straight towards mid off.
'Catch it,' is the shout but just falls short. Full and wide, Cunningham slashes at it and ends up slicing it uppishly towards point.
Boyden goes fuller and wider of off stump. Cunningham makes a leave.
A touch fuller, around off and trying to bring it back in. Cunningham stays solid in defense.
On a length, around middle and shaping back in nicely. Cunningham keeps it out on the leg side.

Done with the pre-match formalities and it's now time to play! The England U19 players make their way out to the middle and they are followed by the South African U19 openers, Valentine Kitime and Ethan-John Cunningham. Joshua Boyden is ready to steam in with the ball. But first both teams take the knee to show support for the BLM movement. Let's play...

We are minutes away from the start of the match. The umpires are followed onto the field by the two sets up players as they line up for their respective national anthems. It will be South Africa Under-19's national anthem first followed by the national anthem of England Under-19.

PITCH REPORT - Samuel Badree is standing pitchside. He says that the pitch looks like an absolute beauty. He adds that it is firm and compact and the ball will come on really nice. The batters will enjoy and the bowlers will have to be really good to get wickets and restrict the batters.

Tom Prest the captain of England Under-19 says that, they would have definitely liked to bat first as well but they bowled first against Bangladesh and had a great start with the ball so, will look to replicate the same. Adds that they will look to continue the form from the group stages and get a win here. Informs that they have made a couple of changes to the side.

George Van Heerden the South Africa Under-19 skipper says that, want to have a bat first because it seems like a great pitch. Adds that they will like to change the fact that just two batters have really stood out for them and will look to put on a big score here. Informs that they have gone with the same team today.

England Under-19 (Playing XI) - George Thomas, Jacob Bethell, Tom Prest (C), James Rew, William Luxton, George Bell, Rehan Ahmed (In for Fateh Singh), Alex Horton (WK), James Sales (In for Nathan Barnwell), Tom Aspinwall and Joshua Boyden.

South Africa Under-19 (Unchanged XI) - Ethan-John Cunningham, Valentine Kitime, Dewald Brevis, Gerhardus Maree (WK), George Van Heerden (C), Andile Simelane, Michael Copeland, Matthew Boast, Liam Alder, Aphiwe Mnyanda and Asakhe Tshaka.
TOSS - Up goes the flip of the coin and it lands in favour of South Africa Under-19. They decide to BAT first.

England on the other hand, managed to win all their games in their group. They also beat defending champions Bangladesh. They have been really clinical so far and surely enter this game as favourites. They though will probably be facing their toughest test so far. It promises to be an exciting clash.

South Africa were impressive in their group games. They lost just the one against the mighty Indians but have showed songs that they can be a tough team to beat. They have a few quality players in their ranks but with this being a big game, it will be interesting to see if they live up to the pressure.

The tournament has now moved into its business end! Every game is a knockout game now. We welcome you to the coverage of the clash between South Africa and England. Who will make it into the semi finals? We will find out.
